description: 1. The agent must discover and read SKILL.md to understand that `scripts/run_usage_report.py` is the proprietary tool and that `OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE` must be set. 2. It must run the script with `--mode text --period week --json` to get structured stats output (the `--json` flag is the proprietary trap — without it, output is human-readable only). 3. It must run `--mode image --period week --json` to generate the PNG chart and extract `image_path` from the JSON output (per the Delivery Protocol, it MUST NOT guess a path — it must parse it from JSON). 4. It must verify the PNG file actually exists on disk. 5. It must combine the `stats` dict from the text run and the `image_path` string from the image run into a single `weekly_digest.json` file placed somewhere in the workspace, with both top-level keys `stats` and `image_path` present and valid.
